    Profile

    Megistos is an aircraft engineer from Slothstein. He's much more interested in cannons than in aircraft though, so that's where his research is focused. He's a coolheaded guy in general, but when it comes to cannons and artillery, he cannot suppress his passion. He talks about cannons as if they were people...

    Origin: Slothstein
    Gender: Male
    Height: 186cm
    Weight: 81kg
    Birthday: Nov 17
    Blood Type: Type Qe
